sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary, conditional i231v applicability, authoritative owners and paths, declared operands and result, lookup-case relationship, datatypes, and units without executing the informational source formula or imposing universal case existence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional applicability logic. The current ship shape requires every ship to have a bow-subregion case classified as i231v and therefore unconditionally requires all operands/results, which turns the conditional requirement into universal existence constraints. Do not impose sh:minCount 1 on hasBowSubregionCalculationCase solely from this rule, and do not require every linked case to have bowFormApplicabilityClassification = i231vBowFormApplicability.
